name: serpapi_youtube_search
description: Search YouTube videos through SerpApi using keyword queries, with normalized video-first results including title, URL, channel, published date, views, duration, thumbnail, and pagination token. Use this to find YouTube videos when you do not already have a specific URL.

search_query.description: YouTube search keywords. Use anything you would type into normal YouTube search.

sp.description: Optional YouTube filter/pagination token from SerpApi. Can filter by upload date, quality, exact match, or continue to next page.

gl.description: Optional country code for YouTube localization, like us or gb.

hl.description: Optional UI language for search results. Default: en.

num_results.description: How many normalized video results to return, clamped to 1..10. Default: 5.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

extra_params.description: Additional SerpApi YouTube search parameters passed through, excluding reserved keys.

include_raw.description: If true, include the raw SerpApi payload in data.raw.
